overloads.semanticRole: The SET HELP MENU command allows you to replace the default 4D Help menu with the menuCol collection of menu items in the application mode.

constraints: The "Help" label itself is managed by the system and cannot be customized.
Customized Help menus do not support submenus, checkmarks, styles, or icons.
Items display in the same order as the collection; a null entry or empty object inserts a separator line.

menuCol's menu-object properties (title, method, worker, action, shortcutKey, shortcutShift, shortcutAlt) follow the same object shape as other menu-building commands (e.g. SET MENU ITEMS / APPEND MENU ITEM); if 'method' is passed, 'action' is ignored, and vice versa.
